Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Star-Whisper Cottage collects when you visit this website or contact us, and how we use it.

sections.heading: Information you share with us
sections.body: When you message us on WhatsApp or send us an email, we receive the details you choose to share, such as your name, phone number, email address, travel dates and number of guests.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: We use your information only to look after your stay:
items: Answering your questions and confirming bookings
Keeping records required by Malaysian law
Improving the website and our service

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: This website stores your language and theme choice in your browser so it remembers them on your next visit. We may use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use the site. It collects anonymous usage data and does not identify you personally.

sections.heading: Sharing and your rights
sections.body: We never sell your information. You can ask us at any time what we hold about you, or ask us to correct or delete it, by contacting us on WhatsApp or by email.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.intro: These terms apply to bookings at Star-Whisper Cottage and to your use of this website.

sections.heading: Bookings
sections.body: A booking is confirmed once we have agreed your dates with you on WhatsApp or by email and received any deposit we asked for. Rates shown on this website are a guide and may change during holidays and special events.

sections.heading: During your stay
sections.body: To keep the cottage pleasant for every guest, we ask that you:
items: Keep to the number of guests agreed when booking
Respect our neighbours and keep noise down at night
Leave the house as tidy as you found it

sections.heading: Cancellations
sections.body: Cancellation and refund terms are agreed with you when you book. Please contact us as early as possible if your plans change.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: Guests are responsible for any damage caused during their stay and for their own belongings. We are not liable for loss or injury except where required by law.
